gates.name: parse-json-yaml
gates.cmd: git ls-files -z '*.json' '*.yml' '*.yaml' | xargs -0 ruby -rjson -ryaml -e 'j=y=0; ARGV.each{|f| if f.end_with?(".json") then JSON.parse(File.read(f)); j+=1 else YAML.load_file(f); y+=1 end}; abort("0 files parsed") if j==0 || y==0; puts "parsed json=#{j} yaml=#{y}"'
